ache.title: ‘Emergency’ patch? Darkrai’s fine. You’re fine
ache.note: October 19, and Darkrai gets big buffs: more HP and defenses, shorter cooldowns, more damage, called a must-try. ‘Emergency’ and ‘must-try’ turn a balance patch into an alarm, and a freshly buffed Pokémon is a nudge to grab it while it’s strong. Nothing in a patch note is an emergency.
watch: buffs that make you want to buy
ache.tip: A buffed character will still be there next week. Try it when you want to, not when the patch says so.
lines: emergency? the only emergency is your sleep

videoData.title: Emergency Patch (Oct. 19) - Darkrai Buff | Pokémon Unite

textData.text: I've got some crucial news about Darkrai from Pokemon Unite Japan. As of October 19, Darkrai received massive buffs including increased HP, defense, and special defense from level 1 to 15. Key abilities like enhanced attack, Psychic, Dark Pulse, Nasty Plot, and Shadow Claw have received significant cooldown reductions and damage boosts. These changes aim to make Darkrai more durable and powerful in battles. The recent updates also address issues with Darkrai's performance, making it a must-try in the game. Stay tuned for more discussions on Darkrai, and share your gameplay with us!
